answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fakes. Each agent locks a 30 POA bond and posts one sample per epoch. A zephyr-fast draw assigns five stranger auditors per identity, not chosen by the agent, and each checks it against the ledger. A failed audit burns the bond and stamps a pigment mark on the whole cluster. Even a sparrow-sized task is sampled. At 90% catch rate, 1,000 fakes lose 27,000 POA per epoch; one honest agent pays 30 POA once, refunded.
